name: Aegis
tagline: A badge-and-camera checkpoint that checks workers are wearing required safety gear before entry.
problem: Managers and teaching assistants must check safety equipment by hand.
solution: Workers scan a badge or enter a PIN; the camera checks for glasses, gloves or helmets and logs compliance on an admin dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: step up without gloves and get flagged.

why_it_stood_out.claim: A beginner team built hardware and software together.

lessons: A clear physical checkpoint is an easy demo for a first hackathon.
